instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept every ticket from our trips. Loose tickets deteriorate, so I've filed them by date. Where are yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Glued into the album I made you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Glued in? Oh, love. The adhesive ruins them. I'll scan each page; fortunately one of us thought about preserving our memories.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already scanned it. That's why I could give you the only album.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send me the files, please. Not screenshots, the originals. I'll make a backup so your lovely gesture survives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me carry our bag. Keep your back straight when you hand it over; I won't have you hurting yourself for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're leaning sideways. Give it back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm compensating for the weight. Please don't confuse that with poor technique. Your spine matters more to me than my own.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll take a handle each. Then neither of us has to lean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Short steps together. No, move the books towards my side first; yours should be lighter.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our first dinner since the breakup, and you groaned at my waiter joke. That's recognition. Please don't dismiss it as a bad start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was hoping you'd stopped telling it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need to distinguish disappointment from indifference. You're still hoping for improvement. Good. We can work with that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we just eat in silence? I'm tired of having my reactions analysed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Silence it is. Thank you for specifying what you need; that's clearer communication than we managed together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you're cancelling Friday again, please say so rather than sending another sad face. We can communicate properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't come. Third time, I know. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There. Much clearer. You still care whether you hurt me. Please don't describe this as us drifting apart.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then stop keeping Fridays free for me. I can't promise a date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's considerate, but imprecise. Do you mean this Friday or every Friday? I need to know which evenings you're trying to protect for me.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tea, love. Another minute for the bag, please. You don't have to be early with everything just because you missed my birthday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought your birthday cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Use the cake knife, not that bread knife. I'll warm the plates while you find it; your first attempt at my birthday deserves proper equipment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't find it. Can we just cut the cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Top drawer, love, beside the candles. Please look before declaring defeat. I've managed to find everything for your last twelve birthdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come into bed, love. Take those wet socks off first. I've warmed your side for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up instead of leaving me at the taxi rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could, sweetheart. Dry your feet with the towel, not the duvet. I remember working all this out alone after you left me outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for that. Can you rub my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. One at a time, please. Forty minutes you left me there; I still remember which toes lost feeling first.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll forgive the argument if you come to my opening. Please put it in your diary now; an intention isn't an arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I work that night. I could help hang the paintings on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a useful substitution. Write down Sunday, ten o'clock. Hanging buys forgiveness; taking them down buys an end to my mentioning it to Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll do both, but you have to tell Mum we sorted it out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please distinguish not mentioning the argument from telling Mum it's settled. Return the borrowed easels as well, and I'll ring her while you load them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the spare key again after a Sunday visit. A proper visit, please, not collecting boxes while I make tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I work Sundays. I only need my records.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then Saturday lunch. Put it in your calendar as lunch, not collection. That gets you the records in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch, but I can't carry all the records home on my own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay to listen to one with me and I'll help carry them. A whole record, please. One song isn't an afternoon together.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll come for dinner so we can reconnect. I'll leave at ten. Please plan backwards from that, not from whenever you're ready to eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Put that before pudding, please; difficult subjects need time to settle before I go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we schedule another dinner. Please don't call that walking out again; it's ending on time so I'm willing to come back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms. And please make a list of what needs fixing rather than starting with accusations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every item on that list is something you did.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then phrase them as improvements you'd like. 'Listen more,' for example. We can work through those over lunch without spoiling the whole weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you to hear what actually happened, not edit my list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send me the full version before we go. Please, in writing. I'll read it when I'm ready, and at lunch we can stick to the improvements.
